The numerical preflight excludes both as no_size ('no usable size location measurement'), list_series returns nothing for 544838 and prepare emitted this single candidate entry with series=null. The medium_class judgement (colloid, because stage III irradiates the AuNPs(II) nanochain colloid) does not affect this outcome, since no series exists for any medium.
